Contact Form Integration

You can get a website with contact form integration as part of the Launch package for $2,950. This package includes up to 5 pages, custom design, contact forms, and SEO basics, and you'll own the site outright, including the code, content, and domain.

How it Works

The Launch package includes contact forms, allowing visitors to get in touch with you easily. The process takes about a week, and you'll have a fully functional website.

What You Get

The Launch package costs $2,950, with a 50% deposit upfront and the balance due at launch. You'll also get 90 days of free care after launch, and then you can opt for a care plan at $295/month or $595/month, cancelable at any time. Your website will be hosted on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, with $0/month hosting fees.

FAQ

What is included in the Launch package? The Launch package includes up to 5 pages, custom design, contact forms, and SEO basics. How long does it take to get a website with the Launch package? The Launch package takes about a week to complete. Do I own the website outright? Yes, with Everbuilt Studio, you own the website outright, including the code, content, and domain.

To get started with a website that includes contact form integration, learn more about the Launch package on this site.
